```{r pkgs, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(IPDfromKM)
library(survival)
library(simsurv)
library(tidyverse); theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r seed}
set.seed(427)
```

```{r}
data("Radiationdata")

names(Radiationdata)
```

```{r}
radio       <- Radiationdata$radio
trisk       <- Radiationdata$trisk
nrisk_radio <- Radiationdata$nrisk.radio

pre_radio <- preprocess(
  dat  = radio, 
  trisk = trisk,  
  nrisk = nrisk_radio,
  totalpts = NULL,  
  maxy = 100  
)

est_radio <- getIPD(
  prep       = pre_radio,
  armID      = 0,
  tot.events = NULL  
)

head(est_radio$IPD)
```

```{r}
#ipd_radio <- est_radio$IPD
#write.csv(ipd_radio, "ipd_radio.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
radioplus  <- Radiationdata$radioplus
nrisk_radioplus  <- Radiationdata$nrisk.radioplus

pre_radioplus <- preprocess(
  dat  = radioplus,
  trisk  = trisk,
  nrisk  = nrisk_radioplus,
  maxy  = 100
)

est_radioplus <- getIPD(prep = pre_radioplus, armID = 1, tot.events = NULL)

ipd1 <- est_radio$IPD
ipd2 <- est_radioplus$IPD

ipd_all <- rbind(ipd1, ipd2) 

head(ipd_all)
```

```{r}
fit_km <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = ipd_all)
plot(fit_km, col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1:2)
legend("topright", legend = c("RT", "RT + cetuximab"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1:2)
```

```{r}
plot(est_radio)  
surv2 <- survreport(
  ipd1 = est_radio$IPD,
  ipd2 = est_radioplus$IPD,
  arms = 2,
  interval = 8,
  s = c(0.75, 0.5, 0.25),
  showplots = TRUE
)
print(surv2)
```

```{r}
data("imgexp")  

windows()
df_pts <- getpoints(imgexp, 0, 60, 0, 100)
```


```{r}
totalpts <- 213 

pre1 <- preprocess(
  dat  = df_pts,
  trisk = NULL,
  nrisk = NULL,
  totalpts = totalpts,
  maxy = 100
)

est1 <- getIPD(pre1, armID = 0, tot.events = NULL)
head(est1$IPD)

```

```{r}
windows()
df_pts2 <- getpoints(imgexp, 0, 60, 0, 100)

pre2 <- preprocess(dat = df_pts2,
                   trisk = NULL, nrisk = NULL,
                   totalpts = 213, maxy = 100)
est2 <- getIPD(pre2, armID = 0, tot.events = NULL)    
```

```{r}
fit1 <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = est1$IPD)
fit2 <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = est2$IPD)

plot(fit1, conf.int = FALSE, lty = 2) 
lines(fit2, lty = 1)  
points(df_pts$x, df_pts$y/100) 
```
